tasks.title: Announcement #39
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: I want to remind you all that we will have a paper due every Friday. The paper should be a response to the week's reading and should be at least 2 pages long. Papers should be uploaded to the class portal on Fridays by 5 PMI will grade them and send you feedback by the end of the weekend. Late papers will be marked down by one letter grade each day unless you speak with me ahead of time and receive an extension.

questions.stem: What should students do every Friday?

options.B: Upload their papers to be graded
options.D: Check for assignments on the class portal

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：学生每周五需要做什么？ 定位原文：Papers should be uploaded to the class portal on Fridays by 5 PM. 选项分析： A. Begin working on their papers 开始写论文。原文说“提交”，不是“开始”，因此错误。 B. Upload their papers to be graded 上传论文。基于原文直接对应，因此正确。 C. Discuss the reading in groups 小组讨论。未提及，所以错误。 D. Check for assignments 查看作业。无关，因此错误。

questions.stem: What is mentioned as a reason to speak with the professor?

options.A: Requesting an explanation of the grading policy
options.B: Requesting an extension for an assignment
options.C: Asking a question about some reading material
options.D: Asking a question about the topic of a paper

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：什么情况下需要联系教授？ 定位原文：unless you speak with me ahead of time and receive an extension 选项分析： A. 询问评分标准。未提及。 B. 申请延期。基于 extension，因此正确。 C. 问阅读问题。未提及。 D. 问论文主题。未提及。
